sql:
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st ON s.School = st.sname
WHERE st.NumGE1500 > 0 AND st.AvgScrMath + st.AvgScrRead + st.AvgScrWrite > 3 * 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(st.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 > 0 AND sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrWrite > 4500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Phone,
    COUNT(st.NumTstTakr) AS NumTestTakers
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores st ON s.School = st.sname
WHERE 
    st.AvgScrSAT > 1500
GROUP BY 
    s.Phone
ORDER BY 
    NumTestTakers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = SUBSTR(sat.cds, 3)
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st ON f.School Code = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(st.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname AND s.District = sa.dname
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname AND s.District = sa.dname
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 > 0 AND sa.AvgScrSAT > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname AND s.District = sa.dname
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 > 0 AND sa.AvgScrSAT > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 > 0 AND sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrWrite > 4500
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON f.School Code = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON f.School Code = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 1500
ORDER BY sa.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st ON s.School = st.sname
WHERE st.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(st.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 1;
